---
- name: Configure NAT egress on node1 for the private network
  hosts: router
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo

        set nat source rule 100 outbound-interface name {{ wan_iface }}
        set nat source rule 100 source address {{ private_cidr }}
        set nat source rule 100 translation address masquerade
        commit
        save
        exit
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: vyos_nat
      changed_when: "'No configuration changes to commit' not in vyos_nat.stdout"

    - name: Show resulting NAT source rules
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        source /opt/vyatta/etc/functions/script-template
        run show nat source rules
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: nat_rules
      changed_when: false

    - name: Print NAT rules
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: nat_rules.stdout_lines

  hosts: private_clients
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
